R0063.title: Duplicate Product Listings
R0063.definition: A seller excessively lists the same or similar products in their store, resulting in duplicate product listings and redundant inventory.
R0063.description: Duplicate listings generally include: products with highly similar titles, images, key attributes, or descriptions. Listing the same product separately by different colors, sizes, bundles, or specifications is generally considered duplicate listing.
R0063.influence: Degrades the shopping experience and may cause transaction loss; occupies platform search and recommendation resources, damaging the platform's reputation.

observables: Product titles, images, attributes, and descriptions within the same store are highly similar, with a high duplication rate
The same product is split into separate listings by color, size, or bundle, occupying multiple search slots
The store's listing inventory is densely packed with homogeneous links, with exposure resources consumed by a single seller
The same seller's identical products appear densely in search results, crowding out other sellers
